name: pr-master
description: PR panel for Claude Code: your pull requests, review requests and merged pull requests, with whose Turn it is

staleThreshold.title: Stale threshold
staleThreshold.description: Mark pull requests older than this as stale: off, 2w (two weeks), 1m (one month), 3m (three months) or 6m (six months)

reviewWindow.title: Review window
reviewWindow.description: List Review requests opened within this window: off (no limit), 1w (one week), 2w (two weeks) or 1m (one month)

mergedWindow.title: Merged window
mergedWindow.description: List your pull requests merged within this window in the Merged tab: off, 1d (one day), 3d (three days) or 1w (one week)

hiddenOrgs.title: Hidden organisations
hiddenOrgs.description: Organisations (or users) whose pull requests the panel never shows, by login

showPrivate.title: Show private repositories
showPrivate.description: Show pull requests in private repositories

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Raise an Alert, a toast in the session, when a pull request needs you, becomes Ready to merge, reaches production or fails CI after merging

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Used only when `gh auth token` gives none. Needs repo and read:org
